content.short: Demex is a decentralized trading platform focused on onchain order books, perpetuals, lending, and capital-efficient markets.
content.description: Demex presents itself as a decentralized trading platform built for a fully onchain financial system rather than a simple swap interface. Its docs highlight spot, perpetual, and futures trading, alongside lending, borrowing, staking, and liquidity pools within the broader Demex stack. The platform emphasizes onchain order books, fast execution, deep liquidity design, and a model aimed at capital efficiency for active traders. For Mantle users, Demex fits best as a derivatives and advanced trading venue for those who want more than basic token swaps and are comfortable using a market-style interface.
